prose: Joel Rafidi is an awakened Aussie who is kicking ass against tyranny with powerful podcasts, hard hitting hip hop, and a creative flow that no mandate can stop. As co-host of the excellent new show Here For the Truth, Joel has been making waves in the truth community with hard-hitting sojourns into stuff society is shy to speak about. He also provides coaching services for self-seekers with an approach that integrates Human Design, Taroscopes (by Michael Tsarion), and his own life experience of getting healthy inside and out.
